name: TACO: Trash Annotations in Context
annotation_format: COCO instance segmentation; can derive boxes from segmentation/bbox fields
strength: Real-world litter scenes, hierarchical waste taxonomy, masks and boxes
risk: No official train/val/test split; many rare classes; needs COCO-to-YOLO/class-crop conversion
action: Downloaded under external_datasets/hard_case_full/taco_official; use source-aware YOLO split manifest and review 35 fallback-640 images before final annotation training

name: RealWaste
annotation_format: Image classification folders / Hugging Face imagefolder
strength: Authentic landfill reception images; strong hard-case source for material classifier
risk: Classification-only, no boxes; textile/miscellaneous/vegetation labels require careful mapping to WasteWise classes
action: Downloaded under external_datasets/hard_case_full/realwaste_hf_uci; use classifier train/val/test recommendations in source_aware_split_manifest.csv

name: Outerview Global Trash & Debris Index
annotation_format: Hugging Face image/geospatial dataset; image classification and object detection metadata
strength: Geotagged real-world trash and debris observations across varied environments; CC-BY-4.0 sample dataset
risk: Dataset card says it is a sample subset and detection accuracy can vary; labels may be CV-generated rather than manually verified
action: Downloaded metadata and image archive under external_datasets/hard_case_full/outerview_global_trash_debris; keep as OOD review pool until material labels are visually audited

name: OpenLitterMap
annotation_format: Geotagged litter photos with classified tags; export/API access must be verified
strength: Open litter and plastic-pollution observations from real public environments
risk: ODbL attribution/share-alike requirements and export access need review before merging into project data
action: Verify data access and license obligations, then sample environment-litter hard cases for review/OOD evaluation

name: MJU-Waste v1.0
annotation_format: PASCAL VOC; COCO instance annotations also available
strength: Waste object segmentation with RGB-D imagery; official repository and academic citation
risk: Mostly waste-vs-background, not fine-grained material classes; Google Drive download/manual access
action: Use for object-localization/segmentation evidence and feature distribution, not final multi-class sorting alone

name: ZeroWaste
annotation_format: Detection/semantic segmentation in cluttered industrial waste scenes
strength: In-the-wild industrial-grade clutter, useful for real-world robustness
risk: Different domain from household/public litter; download page must be verified before use
action: Treat as external-domain stress test, not direct class-balance replacement

name: TrashCan 1.0
annotation_format: Instance segmentation masks; material and instance label versions
strength: Real-world annotated debris with masks; useful for detection/segmentation discussion
risk: Underwater domain is very different from phone-camera household waste; academic/research-use license
action: Use as 'similar annotated debris dataset' in comparison table; avoid merging into final household sorting unless domain is justified

name: TrashNet
strength: Classic 6-class waste classification baseline; easy to train ANN/CNN/classical features
risk: Clean/staged backgrounds, not TACO-like detection; cannot directly train detector without synthetic/full-image boxes
action: Use for classification baseline only and explicitly mark as clean-background comparison

name: Garbage in Images (GINI)
annotation_format: Bounding boxes for one trash class
strength: Real-world garbage in images; useful for background/negative context and one-class detection
risk: Single class; not enough for material sorting
action: EDA/features only or binary trash-vs-background; do not use as standalone multi-class model

name: PlastOPol (Roboflow v4)
annotation_format: YOLO single-class 'litter'; Roboflow export had segmentation polygons, converted to bboxes
similar_to_taco: low (Marine Debris Tracker ground-level litter, distinct source)
strength: NEW real-world field diversity for class-agnostic detector recall (F11 next lever)
risk: 1-class only -> requires class-agnostic (nc=1) detector; 21/2418 near-dups of existing data dropped
action: clean split at external_datasets/plastopol_clean_v1; audit runs/audits/plastopol_leakage_audit.json
